name: Tau Ceti f
tagline: An t-iarrthóir fuar seachtrach — oll-Domhan trom ag imeall reoite an chrios ináitrithe.

facts.label: Crios
facts.value: Cool outer edge of the habitable zone

history: Tau Ceti f completes the famous candidate pair — a ~6.6 Earth-mass world orbiting just outside the nominal habitable zone, where only a thick CO₂ blanket could keep water liquid. Its 636-day orbit is easier to model but harder to prove: the signal takes two years per cycle and must be sifted from the star's own magnetic murmurs. If real, the pair makes Tau Ceti the nearest plausible two-world laboratory for the question of how far inside a G dwarf's warmth life could reach — a question made urgent because this star is old, calm and only twelve light-years away.
source: Tuomi et al. (2012) · Feng et al. (2017)
